card.name: Section number 3 in Clinical Pharmacology references
card.fires_on: The digit after the decimal point in section cross-references, mainly the 3 in "Clinical Pharmacology (12.3)" after a drug-interaction statement. It also fires weakly on digits in other numbered headings or references like 7.2 or 5.17.

modes.label: Clinical Pharmacology 12.3
modes.description: The digit 3 in a bracketed cross-reference to section 12.3 after a statement about changed drug exposure.
